title: Blind Girl
description:
Blind Girl is a visual novel adventure game in which you explore the world to continue the story.



The poor girl became blind after an evil witch took her eyes. Join her on an epic journey to retrieve them. 



Will she be able to find her eyes?

Is everything really as it seems?

Will there be a happy ending?



Your choices affect the story. It is all up to you!



*Key features

Simple controls using the keyboard.

Mysterious and beautiful graphics.

A fairy tale-like story.

3 possible endings that are affected by the player's choices throughout the story.
description_short: A girl who lost her eyes to the witch is weeping in the darkness. The shadow fairy heard her cries and opens his eyes. This is how their adventure starts. Will they be able to retrieve her eyes? The tale of a blind girl and her shadow fairy begins.
